data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 1.3m (2013: strengthening GBP 2.9m) net of reinsurance was made from prior year reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an aggregate prior-year reserve release of GBP 1.3m net of reinsurance for calendar year 2014. The financial statements do not disclose a corresponding gross (insurance liabilities) prioryear movement figure or a gross claims development triangle; the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 (the 2013 closing balance) was GBP 69.876m. The reported net release appears to arise from favourable claims development; no LOBlevel gross prior year movements are provided.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 1.3m (2013: strengthening GBP 2.9m) net of reinsurance was made from prior year reserves.
data.data_quality_notes: The report states a net prioryear reserve release of GBP 1.3m (net of reinsurance) but does not present a corresponding GROSS (insurance liabilities) prioryear movement table or a gross claims development triangle. The only explicit gross claims balances are the balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' (2014: GBP 76.621m; 2013: GBP 69.876m). Because the required GROSS prioryear movement amount is not shown, prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. No LOB-level gross prior year movements or named prior-year events impacting reserves are provided in the notes scanned.
